title: User Registration Success
description: Verify that a new user can successfully register with valid credentials.

steps.description: Open the registration page.
Enter valid email, username, and password.
Submit the registration form.
Verify registration success message is displayed and user is redirected to login page.

title: User Registration with Existing Email
description: Verify system handles registration attempts using an already registered email address gracefully.

steps.description: Open the registration page.
Enter an email already registered in the system.
Submit the registration form.
Verify appropriate error message is shown indicating the email is already in use.

title: User Login Success
description: Verify that registered users can login using correct credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Input valid username/email and password.
Click the login button.
Check that user is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

title: User Login Failure with Incorrect Password
description: Verify that the system prevents login with incorrect password.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Input valid username/email with incorrect password.
Click the login button.
Verify error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify that users with different roles have appropriate access to features and admin panel sections.

steps.description: Log in as a standard user.
Verify admin panel and restricted features are not accessible.
Log out and log in as an admin user.
Verify full access to admin panel tabs including bugs, suggestions, user management, changelogs, and Ko-fi integration.

title: Bug Report Submission with Valid Data
description: Verify users can create bug reports with complete metadata including version, severity, and status.

steps.description: Log in as a valid user.
Open the bug report submission form.
Fill out required fields including bug title, description, mod version, severity level, and initial status.
Submit the bug report.
Verify bug report is saved and listed with correct metadata in bug list.

title: Bug Report Submission with Missing Required Fields
description: Verify that the bug report form validation works and prevents submission if required fields are missing.

steps.description: Open the bug report form.
Attempt to submit the form with empty mandatory fields such as title or description.
Verify validation errors are displayed and form submission is blocked.

title: Suggestion Submission with Category and Priority
description: Verify that users can submit feature suggestions with appropriate categorization and priority levels.

steps.description: Open the suggestion submission form.
Fill out suggestion description, select category and priority.
Submit the suggestion.
Verify suggestion appears in the suggestions list with correct details.

title: User Profile Update and Minecraft Account Linking
description: Verify that users can link their Minecraft accounts via the Mojang API and that account linking status updates correctly.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to profile settings.
Enter a valid Minecraft username to link.
Submit link request.
Verify linking is successful and Minecraft account status is reflected on the profile page.

title: User Profile Minecraft Linking with Invalid Username
description: Verify that linking fails gracefully with invalid or non-existent Minecraft usernames.

steps.description: Enter an invalid or non-existent Minecraft username in profile linking.
Submit the linking request.
Verify appropriate error message is shown and linking is not saved.

title: Ko-fi Subscription Tier Creation and Update in Admin Panel
description: Verify that admins can create, update, and delete Ko-fi subscription tiers via the admin panel without UI issues.

steps.description: Log in as admin and open Ko-fi integration tab in Admin Panel.
Create a new subscription tier with name, price, and reward details.
Verify the new tier appears correctly in the list and persists in the database.
Edit the subscription tier details.
Verify updates are saved and displayed without UI breakage or modal syntax errors.
Delete the created subscription tier.
Verify tier is removed from the list and database.

title: Ko-fi Webhook Payment Processing
description: Verify that receiving a valid Ko-fi webhook updates user subscription status correctly and logs event for traceability.

steps.description: Simulate a Ko-fi webhook call with valid payment payload and verification token.
Verify user subscription status is updated in the database, payment details are recorded, and webhook event is logged.

title: Ko-fi Webhook Handling with Invalid Verification Token
description: Verify that webhook calls with invalid verification tokens are rejected and logged without altering data.

steps.description: Send Ko-fi webhook with an invalid or missing verification token.
Verify webhook is rejected with an error response and the event is logged for security audit.

title: Minecraft API Endpoint - Subscription Reward Verification
description: Verify that the Minecraft mod API endpoint correctly validates linked accounts and returns current subscription tiers and manual rewards for the player.

steps.description: Call the Minecraft mod’s subscription API endpoint on player login with a linked Minecraft username.
Verify response includes correct subscription tier data, manual rewards, and that rewards statuses are updated as granted.

title: Minecraft API Endpoint - Unlinked Account Handling
description: Verify Minecraft API returns appropriate response when player Minecraft account is not linked to a user.

steps.description: Call the Minecraft mod API endpoint with a Minecraft username that is not linked.
Verify the API returns a response indicating no linked subscription or rewards without failure.

title: AI Bug Analysis Processing
description: Verify that newly submitted bug reports trigger AI analysis and receive automatic prioritization and classification tags.

steps.description: Submit a new bug report with typical descriptive data.
Verify that the AI service processes the bug report and updates the bug record with classification and prioritization metadata.

title: Admin Panel Full CRUD on Bug Records
description: Verify admin users can view, create, update, and delete bug records through the admin panel interface without UI defects.

steps.description: Log in as admin and navigate to the bug management tab.
Create a new bug entry using the admin interface.
Verify the new bug appears in the bugs list.
Edit bug details including status and severity.
Verify the changes persist and are reflected in the UI without modal syntax errors.
Delete the created bug record.
Verify bug is removed both from database and UI.

title: Changelog Creation and Editing
description: Verify that admins can create and edit version changelogs with markdown formatting correctly via the admin panel.

steps.description: Log in as admin and navigate to changelog section.
Create a new changelog entry including markdown formatting in the description.
Verify the changelog entry displays with correct markdown rendering.
Edit the changelog and save changes.
Verify edits are saved and displayed correctly.

title: Data Persistence and MongoDB Version Control
description: Verify that all bug reports, suggestions, and user profiles are correctly saved in MongoDB with accurate versioning and data integrity.

steps.description: Create, update, and delete bug reports and suggestions.
Update user profiles including role and linked accounts.
Verify data in MongoDB reflects operations with proper version control and no data loss or corruption.

title: CurseForge API Integration - Mod Information Display
description: Verify that mod information fetched from the CurseForge API is correctly displayed on the landing hero section and related UI components.

steps.description: Load the landing page with CurseForge integration enabled.
Verify mod details such as version, description, and download stats are displayed accurately.

title: Responsive UI Component Rendering
description: Verify that the navigation bar, footer, and hero section render correctly and respond properly to various screen sizes.

steps.description: Open the website on desktop, tablet, and mobile device viewports.
Verify all UI components adapt layout without overlap, truncation, or broken elements.

title: Manual Reward Assignment via Admin Panel Ko-fi Tab
description: Verify that admins can manually assign rewards to subscribers, and that those rewards are delivered properly on next Minecraft login.

steps.description: Log in as admin and navigate to Ko-fi tab in admin panel.
Manually assign a reward to a subscriber user.
Verify the reward is recorded as pending grant.
Simulate player login via Minecraft mod querying rewards API.
Verify the manual reward is granted in-game and marked as granted in the database.

title: Environment Variable Configuration Validation
description: Verify system behaves correctly when required environment variables (e.g., KOFI_VERIFICATION_TOKEN, MONGODB_URI) are set or missing.

steps.description: Start the system with all required environment variables set correctly.
Verify system initializes without errors and external integrations function normally.
Restart the system with a critical environment variable missing or invalid.
Verify system logs errors and fails safe without exposing sensitive information.

title: User Experience on Bug Report Submission
description: Verify that users receive clear success or error feedback when submitting bug reports and linking Minecraft accounts.

steps.description: Submit a new bug report with valid and invalid data respectively.
Verify visible success message on valid submission and appropriate error messages on invalid submission.
Attempt to link Minecraft account with valid and invalid usernames.
Verify success and error feedback is promptly displayed in the UI.

title: System Logs Webhook and Payment History Events
description: Verify that webhook event processing and user subscription payment histories are logged comprehensively for auditing and debugging.

steps.description: Trigger several Ko-fi webhook events (valid and invalid).
Verify that logs capture event details, processing outcomes, and error conditions for traceability.
